change_summary: Restore native full-frame source draw HRESULT revocation for R26-safe menu, car-select and race draw hook variants, including fixed-function sprite, direct XYZRHW, delegated R29/R26, VB/IB and UP. Speculative D3D11 frame is revoked on D3D9 HRESULT failure without altering original return, input or DX9Ex fallback.

integration_path: live game VB/IB/UP R26-safe source Draw capture
post-call original HRESULT reconciliation across R26/R29/XYZRHW/sprite
native full-frame publication revocation before same-device Present
batch_components: D3D9 R26-safe four Draw hook HRESULT ownership
native live_game_frame_bridge failed source draw rollback
destructive source regression for all return branches

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: All source variants record successful Draw and preserve original HRESULT and gamepad route, existing C++ frame batch probe.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Four R26-safe hooks and indexed fixed-function sprite early-return must revoke speculative native scene on FAILED HRESULT; destructive source mutations caught.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 hook callsite -> observe_failed_game_draw -> full-frame batch abort -> no same-Present native publication in existing bridge.

development_strategy.blocking_evidence: R30 normal variant calls observe_failed_game_draw on failed game HRESULT; R30 R26-safe variant had four missing hook result calls plus a sprite early return, allowing failed speculative native full-frame pixels.
development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: No native full-size menu/car-select/race frame may publish pixels after its original D3D9 Draw fails. Source/build verification separate from Quest3 display parity.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: NativeDrawPathActive opt-in remains false by default; original D3D9 HRESULT/input, fallback rendering and game Present remain authoritative.

feature_contract.goal: Ensure all original D3D9 R26-safe menu, vehicle selection and racing Draw return paths revoke a speculative full-frame native D3D11 scene on failure, preserving game input and DX9Ex fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Four R26-safe game Draw hooks reconcile original results before native full-frame output.
Early sprite and XYZRHW as well as delegated failure paths revoke speculative frames without replacing HRESULT/input.
One final validation-bearing SHA passes mandatory DX11 Fast, Backend, Build, OpenXR and HUD workflows.
